decision.nextBoundedAction: Keep both candidates metadata-only. First preregister an offline successor dispatch contract and pure bundle builder that preserve the historical protocol, audit, adapter, ledger, runner preflight, and formal runner as immutable evidence; separate static governance, dispatch-time source freshness, and independent authority; normalize the plural replacement field without accepting the historical singular alias; and exclude the formal weak-acceptance policy shell. A later separately authorized diagnostic runner or shared transport integration must add one live ledger authority, durable pre-send thread and turn intents, snapshot-only materialization after reservation, and an explicit closeable app-server owner. Reconcile cross-process exclusion and crash recovery before any candidate or model request.
